data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ‘tárra’, which means ‘lady’ or ‘maiden’. In Greek mythology, Tarra was a nymph who represented the earth. Parents who choose Tarra usually hope their child will grow to embody lady, maiden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
